title: Qormaata Dhagaa Barreessaa
intro: Hawaasni, ogummaa fi boonsaan, hambaa isaanii gaaruma keessa boce. Garuu yeroo mallattoon ifa ta’e, qormaanni amantii fi of qabuu isaaniif ergamu, of tuuluun isaanii daandii deebi’uu hin dandeenye irra isaan geesse. Garee kanaa fi bu’aa mormii isaanii adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Gooftota dhagaa kan turre siʼa taʼu, manneen jireenyaa dinqisiisoo kallattiin gara qarqara gaaraatti bocna turre.
Ergamaan tokko saba keenya keessaa gara keenya dhufee, Waaqa Tokkicha Dhugaa waaqeffachuuf nu waame.
Jecha isaa mirkaneessuuf mallattoo gaafanne, uumamni adda ta'e tokkos qormaata nuuf ta'e.
Ajajni salphaan nuuf kenname: madda bishaanii keenya uumama kanaaf akka qoodnu, guyyaa murtaa’etti akka dhugu gochuu.
Of tuulummaa keenya keessatti muraasni keenya shira xaxanii akeekkachiisa sana mormuudhaan uumama mallattoo keenya ta’uuf yaadame rukunnee kuffifne.
Balaan keenya dura guyyaa sadii kan nuuf kenname siʼa taʼu, achiis dhohinsi cimaan mana keenya keessatti nu qabee lubbuu dhabnee garagalchinee nu hafe.

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
